Article-era (2012) world electricity as average power: about 2.2 TW (IEA chart read by Codex, 19,550 TWh), about 2.5 TW (EIA net generation 21.6 PWh) and about 2.6 TW (UN yearbook 22,695 TWh; EIA and UN figures from search summaries, not read in full), so 5 PW is about 1,900 to 2,250 times the average; with the modern 2023 figure used earlier (3.36 TW) it is 1,486 times, an era mismatch. Under none of these is it 2x. 5 TW would be about 2x, an arithmetic observation, NOT a claim about what the authors meant; units need the authors' confirmation. Video audio not listened to.
